node.label: Costal cartilage calcification
node.definition: Calcification of the costal cartilages, which are bars of hyaline cartilage found at the anterior ends of the ribs which serve to prolong the ribs forward and contribute to the elasticity of the walls of the thorax.

evidence.snippet: Greenberg skeletal dysplasia: Costal cartilage calcification (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
